newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart stake falls in Montedison.
newsitem.headline: Compart stake falls in Montedison.

text.p: Italian financial holding company Compart, formerly Ferruzzi Finanziaria, reported its stake in agro-business and chemicals group Montedison had fallen since the exercising of Montedison warrants at the end of 1996.

A Montedison tombstone published in newspapers said Compart's stake had fallen to 30.95 percent following the exercising of Montedison warrants 1994-1997 at the end of last year. Previously, Compart held 33.4 percent of Montedison.
The tombstone said that some 28.24 percent of Montedison is held directly by Compart, and the rest by connected companies.

In 1993, both Ferruzzi and Montedison were rescued from financial collapse by a group of banks, and have been restructuring themselves since then towards full recovery. Ferruzzi changed its name to Compart last year.
